# Report framework

Our report, a commitment to transparency and transformation

- Report Framework

For the past eight years, we have prepared our annual report in accordance with the GRI Standards of the **Global Reporting Initiative.** This internationally recognized framework allows us to communicate clearly and systematically the University's main economic, environmental, and social impacts. It offers our readers a comprehensive overview of our relevant sustainability issues and the monitoring of our indicators over time.

###### Stakeholder groups

**GRI 2-29**

We are a living and open system, a web of connections in which **more than 120,000 people and 360 organizations** come together to inspire lives, create knowledge and transform society.

**We organize our stakeholders into three concentric circles** that allow us to visualize the University's relational dynamics. The first circle includes those stakeholders with whom we create knowledge and solutions. In this sphere, in addition to our EAFIT community, we also include businesses, public systems, and entrepreneurial ventures.

In the second circle, we recognize actors who, in different ways, help us strengthen and advance our educational, cultural, scientific, philanthropic, and social project. Finally, the outer circle includes actors who influence agendas relevant to our university work and with whom we interact directly and indirectly to transform lives through education.

###### Value network impacts

**GRI 2-6**

We see ourselves as a living, open ecosystem. A network of connections that continuously receives and gives. We connect with organizations and society to sow and cultivate a humanist and scientific educational project that generates value and sustainable development.

###### Material issues of sustainability

GRI 2-14; 3-2

Due to their significant impact and relevance to the University and its stakeholders, we have defined these material themes, which become essential commitments of EAFIT. By intentionally incorporating and mainstreaming them into everything we do, we contribute to building in the present that imagined future of a society that generates economic and social development in harmony with nature.

## Campus for the Future - University Park

A campus where infrastructure, connection with nature, technology, and knowledge resources translate into learning, connection, and creation.

## Ciencia, tecnología e innovación

​Un lugar que siembra curiosidad desde la infancia y nutre las vocaciones científicas a lo largo de la vida creando soluciones para las organizaciones y la sociedad.​

## Compromiso social ​y cívico

Una comunidad de conocimientos y saberes conectada con las realidades sociales y activa como agente de cambio y transformación.​

## Conexión con​ las organizaciones

Una Institución que desarrolla y pone al servicio de las organizaciones capacidades y soluciones que dan respuesta a retos concretos y crean nuevas posibilidades.

## Cuidado y bienestar

Espacios y experiencias universitarias que invitan al cuidado y valoran la salud física, mental y emocional del ser humano.​

## Excelencia y reconocimiento

Momentos y posibilidades en los que los grupos de interés reconocen nuestro esfuerzo por un aprendizaje constante que invoca un propósito superior.

## Inclusión, diversidad y pluralismo

Momentos y posibilidades en los que los grupos de interés reconocen nuestro esfuerzo por un aprendizaje constante que invoca un propósito superior.​

## Proyecto cultural

Una Institución que invita a sentir y vivir la cultura para contribuir a una experiencia universitaria integral.​

## Regionalización, internacionalización y proyección

Una Universidad que teje y conecta diversos territorios y sus realidades.​

## Relaciones​ con la naturaleza

Una Institución que contribuye a una sociedad que integra su relación con la naturaleza en toda su experiencia vital, reconociéndose como parte de sistemas biológicos.

## Sostenibilidad financiera y administrativa

Una comunidad que cuida los recursos, ​explora y crea nuevas posibilidades que contribuyen a la sostenibilidad de la Universidad presente y futura.​

## Tr​ansformación del modelo educativo

Una Universidad que se compromete con una educación flexible y relevante para dar respuesta a los retos de la humanidad y construir el futuro desde el presente.

## Transformación y cultura organizacional

Una Universidad que transforma su cultura organizacional para ser más dinámica, flexible y generadora de cambio.

###### Contribución a la Agenda​​​ 2030

**GRI 2-22**

The 2030 Agenda is a shared vision for humanity that invites us to see ourselves as a network of interconnected, interdependent beings with the capacity for continuous creation and transformation. It is with this hopeful perspective that EAFIT contributes, through science and humanism, to the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), and in particular to five of them, which are an essential part of our educational project.

[![Image of a roulette wheel with several representations](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/965478a0-8e1c-4095-b336-baa89ca07399/web/ods.png)](https://www.eafit.edu.co/informes-de-gestion-y-sostenibilidad/informe-sostenibilidad-2023/marco-deporte)

![](https://www.eafit.edu.co/informes-de-gestion-y-sostenibilidad/informe-sostenibilidad-2023/marco-deporte)

To highlight this commitment and inspire others to join, we adhere to the United Nations Global Compact and link the SDGs to our mission pillars.
